name: Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1964, Kovilpatti Lakshmi Roller Flour Mills Ltd is in the business of Food Processing and Engineering[1]
keyPoints:
Business Divisions:[1]
a) Food division:
The food division is engaged in the manufacturing  of wheat flour and other related food products
b) Engineering division:
It is engaged in the manufacturing of casting components for automobiles, earthmovers, agricultural machinery, textile machinery, 
 pumps and general engineering industries

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 23.9%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 26.0 days to 18.8 days
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 8.87% over last 3 years.
